sections.Profile:
"Barnyard," released by Multimorphic in 2017, is an engaging add-on game for the P3 Pinball Platform, designed to introduce young children to pinball. This software-only game is compatible with any existing playfield module on the P3 system, eliminating the need for additional hardware.

- Manufacturer: Multimorphic
- Years made: 2017
- In production: yes
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Farming, 2010s, Original Theme, Solid State, P3, Module Game
